Egocentric Human Vision and Touch for Visual–Tactile Learning

[!NOTE]
Release status: this repository currently hosts 100 hours of TouchScale. The full 500-hour dataset is planned for public release before November 2026.




	
		
	
	
		Overview
	

TouchScale captures how people see and feel everyday manipulation. Participants wear a unified capture rig — a
head-mounted RGB-D camera, two wrist cameras and full-hand tactile gloves with 880 taxels… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/2077AIDataFoundation/TouchScale.
